title: Plan a month of content in one afternoon
hook: Plan a month of content in one afternoon
summary: 53 carousels. Only 15 ideas. I stopped hunting for new ones.
body: 53 carousels. Only 15 ideas. I stopped hunting for new ones.

Once a month I pick one topic and give Claude my proof: the reel transcript, a few screenshots, numbers I can show. It turns that into 10 posts, two each as a how-to, a mistake, an opinion, a checklist and a story. Then I spread them over four weeks in my Notion content calendar.
Every post gets its own numbered folder, so I can see which ideas keep paying off.
The prompt is on slide 8. Save it for your next planning day.
Comment "PLAN" and I'll DM you the full prompt and my four-week calendar layout.
